summary: EgyptAir Flight 763 was a non-scheduled international passenger flight from Cairo, Egypt, to Aden, South Yemen. On 19 March 1972 it was operated by the newly renamed EgyptAir using a McDonnell Douglas DC9-32 registered in Yugoslavia as YU-AHR. The aircraft crashed into the Shamsan Mountains while approaching Aden, killing all 30 people on board.
one_line: A 1972 non-scheduled EgyptAir passenger flight from Cairo to Aden that crashed into the Shamsan Mountains, killing all 30 aboard.
key_facts: EgyptAir Flight 763 was an international non-scheduled passenger flight from Cairo, Egypt, to Aden, South Yemen.
The aircraft was a McDonnell Douglas DC9-32.
The aircraft was registered in Yugoslavia as YU-AHR.
The flight was operated by the newly renamed EgyptAir.
The aircraft crashed into the Shamsan Mountains on approach to Aden.
The crash killed all 30 people on board.
The flight's destination was Aden, South Yemen.
